conformance.note: SEM-STA-045 carries no reference forecast and requires a native run. SEM-DET-049 and SEM-DET-050 are resource-determinism cases and arrive with levelling in P6. Every other case is what the CPM engine must pass at the P1 gate - the executable count above, which the gate text is tested against; the corpus as a whole is what bounds the engine's claims.

dependencies.note: No Primavera file exists anywhere in the estate. Until one arrives the XER reader has no file oracle, P6 lag-calendar semantics stay a hypothesis, and every P6 writer stays diagnostic.

dependencies.what: A real CMMS extract - SAP IW37N/IW39, Maximo WOTRACK or Oracle eAM operations - even anonymised
dependencies.note: The P4 gate is satisfiable on synthetic fixtures by its own wording. This dependency gates the named adapters leaving diagnostic, not the phase.

dependencies.note: Exists; three round trips ran on it in August. Each register entry costs about half a day and is outside the slice estimates.

dependencies.note: Every vendor's flat-file path is site-specific, so no adapter can claim more than diagnostic without one.

dependencies.what: The untouched BOILER source e6a3739976580e21 that both evidence lines cite
dependencies.note: Recovered 2026-09-03 from the Shutdown Tracker source-consolidation package (03_ms_project_fixtures); SHA-256 matches results/phase1 and the frozen native round-trip register exactly. It sits with the other real schedules outside git; fixtures/README.md has the hash and provenance.

dependencies.what: A durable off-machine copy of the day-5 candidate schedule, the only file carrying an activity that has started and not finished
dependencies.note: Two copies now exist on this machine and both are read-only, but they share one filesystem and the file has no upstream. S5 measured what it is and is not evidence for: its early dates are its actuals, so it is an oracle for reported work, but its late dates were never recalculated by Project and its slack describes a plan that no longer exists. The criticality rules rest on boiler-after-native-progress.xml and boiler-roundtrip-project-saved-task43.xml instead, and both are recoverable from Shutdown-Tracker-Claude. What would be lost with this file is the estate's only in-progress row and its only eight-row progressed cohort.

rules.summary: sto.core depends on the standard library alone, so hashing stays testable without a database and no validation library can reorder a field and move a hash
Real customer schedule content and credentials never enter the repository
Engine claims are bounded by the semantic conformance corpus as well as by the file oracle; the corpus and its executable subset are counted in the conformance block, never in prose
A writer claims native-evidence-derived only when the register holds an entry for that target system and that application build
The live schedule may change automatically; the exported forecast moves only through supervisor then planner review
Schema changes are new versioned files under infra/migrations; an applied migration is never rewritten
sto.legacy is the oracle the new engine and the sidecar are checked against, and is deleted once that cross-check is green on every fixture
